description: CUDA ptxas evidence for the remaining #140 integer family and residual scalar/packed arithmetic forms. Every case is a complete PTX module. ptxas acceptance is syntax/target evidence only and does not prove runtime behavior.

frontend_scope.working_tree_scope: Evidence was collected against the current working tree based on the base commit. This record covers only the remaining integer-family probes and does not claim frontend implementation or runtime execution.

capture_notes: Each source is embedded below and each replay uses relative case.ptx/case.o names in its own working_directory.
ptxas diagnostic source paths were normalized from the temporary harness directory to the embedded original_source_file; diagnostic status and text are otherwise preserved.
PTX 9.2/9.3 cases rejected because this CUDA 13.1 ptxas reports PTX version 9.1 are classified tool_unavailable, not frontend contract failures.

single_case_replay.description: Select a case by id, write its source_text as case.ptx under the case replay working_directory, then run its replay.argv there.
single_case_replay.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, subprocess
j=json.load(open("docs/integer_arithmetic_ptxas.json"))
c=next(x for x in j["cases"] if x["id"]=="CASE_ID")
wd=pathlib.Path(c["replay"]["working_directory"]); wd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(wd/c["source_file"]).write_text(c["source_text"])
subprocess.run(c["replay"]["argv"], cwd=wd, check=False)
PY
